brief:
A Palestinian journalist killed in an Israeli strike in Gaza has been posthumously awarded the Rory Peck Award for Bravery in Journalism, Al-Monitor reported. The prize recognizes journalists who risk their lives to report on conflict and crisis.

The Rory Peck Trust established the annual award to honor reporters killed or injured while covering dangerous stories. Journalists covering Gaza have faced repeated casualties during the conflict.
title: Israeli strike kills Palestinian journalist awarded Rory Peck prize
